title: trackerboard board
description: Input to `trackerboard import --from FILE [--replace]`. Only `waves`, wave `id` and phase `id` are required; every other field defaults to empty (status to todo). Unknown fields are rejected.

name.description: Board name (letters, digits, . _ -). The import command's name argument overrides it.

title.description: Page heading. Defaults to the name.

repoUrl.description: https://github.com/OWNER/NAME. Bare #N references in PR and issue fields link here, and `trackerboard github` reads this repo.

waves.description: Ordered stages. A board with one untitled wave shows no wave header.

log.description: Change log, newest first. On --replace these entries are merged with the board's own log.

layout.description: Computed graph layout; ignored on import.

prefix.description: Id prefix that routes new phases to this wave.

status.description: todo | active | review | waiting | blocked | done | ongoing | external | dropped. Aliases such as planned, in_progress, merged and shipped are accepted.

note.description: One line shown under the status.

deps.description: Ids of phases this one needs. A list, or a comma-separated string.
